title: Ridgeline Installation Services Measure Fee Credit Against the Contract Price
content:
On a Ridgeline Installation Services program whose measure fee is creditable, the measure fee paid on a contract is credited against that same contract's price as one credit line of the type "measure fee credit", referencing the measure fee line. The credit equals the measure fee charged on the contract.

## Time condition

The agreement must be signed no later than the program's credit-window days, in calendar days, after the measure was completed. Days are counted as calendar days from the measure completion date as day 0 to the contract signing date; signing on the last day of the window qualifies. Both dates are read from the contract record, never from the customer's recollection.

| Measure completed (day 0, hypothetical) | Credit window | Last qualifying signing date | Signed on | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 April | 30 days | 10 May | 10 May (day 30) | yes |
| 10 April | 30 days | 10 May | 11 May (day 31) | no |
| 1 March | 45 days | 15 April | 14 April (day 44) | yes |
| 1 March | 45 days | 15 April | 16 April (day 46) | no |

## Limits of the credit

A measure fee credit is applied at most once per contract and only to the contract that charged the fee; it is never transferred to another program or address, never paid out in cash, and it is void when the agreement is rescinded.

- A contract that already carries a measure fee credit line receives no second one.
- A measure fee paid on a contract for one program or address is not credited to a contract for another program or address.
- On a program whose measure fee is not creditable, no measure fee credit arises.

**Hypothetical amount check.** A contract that charged a measure fee of 99.00 and was signed inside the window carries one measure fee credit of 99.00.
